---
title: "Downstream analysis"
description: "Move from project QC and observed transformed intensities to Recommended DEP, enrichment, GSEA and pathway interpretation."
---

## Current analysis logic

ProtVis 0.9.1 separates **visual/QC matrices** from the **default inferential matrix**. Overview/QC can use normalized data, but **Recommended DEP** deliberately analyzes the observed transformed Step4 matrix before imputation.

Recommended order:

1. **Project Dashboard** — confirm current workflow/run validity and project-wide QC.
2. **Overview & QC** — correlation, expression heatmap, archived UMAP reproduction, normalized intensity density and protein CV.
3. **DEP analysis** — use Recommended DEP for new work; use Archived reproduction only for historical comparability.
4. **Enrichment analysis** — standard GO/KEGG ORA or the directional KEGG reproduction workspace.
5. **GSEA** — standard ranked-list GSEA or B73-Y12 figure reproduction from stored DEP results.
6. **Pathview** — project pathway-level effects onto KEGG maps.
7. Add **STRINGdb PPI, WGCNA, co-enrichment, metaproteomics** or other specialized modules when they answer the biological question.

## Recommended DEP versus complete-matrix analyses

Imputation and normalization remain valuable for visualization and methods that require a complete matrix. They are not automatically appropriate for hypothesis testing. Recommended DEP uses observed values, detection filtering and robust limma statistics so missing observations are not converted into artificial inferential evidence.

Presence/absence candidates—proteins observed repeatedly in only one comparison group—are retained as a **parallel evidence stream** rather than being forced into ordinary fold-change statistics.

## Reproduction modes

Some modules now have explicit historical-reproduction modes. These are intended to match archived manuscript figures/settings and should not be confused with the recommended default for a new experiment.

::: {.callout-important}
Changing plot aesthetics does not change the model; changing the input matrix, detection filter, ranking metric, FDR/effect-size threshold or statistical engine does. Preserve these analysis settings in the schema-v4 run record and manuscript Methods.
:::

## Storage

Downstream analyses append immutable runs to `ProtVis_dataset`. Tables, statistics, plot data/configuration, files and upstream dependencies are stored without overwriting previous executions. Re-running an upstream stage can invalidate downstream nodes while retaining their historical results.
